The moisturizer has a slight scent, but nothing you can smell once applied to the face. I have not broken out from using this product nor did it make me oily. High marks for the gentle fragrance, mint, are in order. Biggest criticism is the expense of purchase--I can buy quarts of other moisturizers for the $42.00 asking price. reviews.t: I have found a new product line! Works wonderful!
reviews.x: I waited until I used the product  for a week before writing any review.  I have many allergies to product's and very sensitive skin.  I was very excited to try this product but hesitant as I usually have issues after day 2 to 3.  Well after a week of using all three product I am excited to say I can feel a huge difference in my skin hydration.  I have less wrinkles-cracks from the dryness.  I have used the products together and would say jump in!  They are great!  Not one issue with irritation

To make it worse, the pump can only get about half of the cream out, then it's a struggle to get the rest. So, the reality is that you're getting about  1/2 of 1 oz of product. I have been using all three products as a system for a few weeks now and I can't say that I'm a fan.  I have to admit that I'm a 45 year old woman who has little by way of wrinkles, but there are a couple of trouble spots that I was hoping this would help - some fine lines on my forehead and between my eyes at the bridge of my n

This moisturizer arrived with a defective pump top dispenser. I tried running it under hot water and still couldn't get it to work. I understand that problems happen from time to time and contacted the seller to kindly inform them of my problem with this item.  No response. I contacted the seller twice more over the next four days to arrange for an exchange and still have never heard one single reply. < Discount provided for evaluation and review

Am happy with product, will buy again. EXCELLENT VENDOR. Have now finished first bottle and can say it is an excellent moisturizer with its effects lasting all day. My skin feels nourished and smooth and after using almost a month, I am starting to see softening of my wrinkles. I am 68 and have not used a product that has ever helped me as much as this. Good pump on the bottle and feels silky on application

I am 64 years old with very dry skin. This cream to me is for someone younger. When I put it on my face, it was hard to spread. To me it just wasn't creamy and rich enough. The smell was nice, but did not deliver the results I was looking for.

Used after applying the RegenFX Ultimate Hyaluronic Acid Serum.  Seems to dry as it goes on and it does not spread evenly.  My liquid face make up does not go on smoothly.on top of it.  Stopped using it and went back to Este Lauder
As most, it moisturizes but no big difference in 5 weeks, guess it will have to take much longer!!

reviews.t: It's really just another nice moisturizer, if not way overpriced
reviews.x: The infomercial's actors may be using the free products but they must also have had more aggressive help from their dermatologist or plastic surgeon, including Jane Seymour, whom I adore. It just didn't live up to the hype but I really wanted it to work!! I'm 57, stay active, eat right and look youthful "for my age" but have to embrace my crepe skin or get regular peels. The two stars is not that I don't like it, it just doesn't do what it says at all, is overpriced as a simple moisturiz

This is a good nightly moisturizer for all skin types. It is lightweight and easily absorbed by the skin, without clogging your pores. It has a slight, minty fragrance, and the first few times I used it I had a tingling sensation on my face. This could be because I'm using multiple products from different product lines and they interact with each other. This sensation stops after a few minutes. The product contains witch hazel, an ingredient known to smooth the skin and reduce breakouts and irri

I love this moisturizer. It absorbs quickly, my skin just drinks it up. It helps me combat the flakiness I sometimes get from the retinol and I wake up with glowing skin. I typically use the non enriched refining moisturizer in the morning under my makeup, as the enriched can be a little heavy for daytime. Though in the dry winter months, I've found myself reaching for this one more frequently. I would highly recommend this moisturizer to those with combo/dry skin, but be careful if you are very

I've tried many moisturizers and this by far is my favorite cream. On top of being cursed with superbly dry skin. I've developed a strange tolerance to skin products that after a while, I would have to switch brands. These factors (plus I always prefer natural ingredients) have made me very picky with moisturizers and lotions etc. I've been using this day cream since Dec 2014--it's a bit pricier than other comparable products but for me, definitely a great investment.

This moisturizer is what I would consider an all season moisturizer. It works well as a winter time moisturizer when the skin is prone to drying out the most and as a warm weather moisturizer because I find that it does not make my combination skin oily. As far as the anti-aging, I have noticed a decreased appearance in my fine lines and it seems like I do not have anymore fine lines coming to sight. Overall, this product is the best!

Have been using this along with the serum for about a week. I love the smell of this - it it's so fresh. Skin is definitely softer & firmer. Have not noticed much of a difference in fine wrinkles but haven't been using long. Overall,  have enjoyed trying this product & have been pleased with the results.  Received complimentary in order to test & review - no compensation was provided.

reviews.t: After a few weeks - still no signs of improvement
reviews.x: Waited a few weeks before writing this review in order to give the product a chance.  Saw no improvement. Tended to dry out my skin (I already have dry skin). Worked less effectively than most of my inexpensive products. I realize moisturizers tend to vary from individual to individual and reviews are subjective. Had high hopes with the many high ratings. Will not be using again

reviews.t: Lovely feeling! Helps appearance of fine line!
reviews.x: I am very pleased with this product especially due to the consistency and how the product feels on my face. I see a slight improvement immediately on my deeper wrinkles but a more noticeable improvement on my less deep wrinkles. I only wish the bottle was a bit larger. It is easy to dispense, spread on the skin & it easily soaks in as well.

The moisturizer is great and the results after a week of using it twice a day, were big. The face feels hydrated and in a mix skin like the one I have felt great. The dry zones and the greasy zones feel hydrated, but not greasy or shiny. The skin feels rejuvenated and especially the lines of the lips are less noticeable.

Feels great on my sensitive skin. Many moisturizers burn my face, but not this one. I have been using this product for a year now and will continue to use it. My makeup goes on smoothly and I feel like my complexion looks more youthful with this product.

reviews.t: I thought I did a good job picking the closest shade but when I received ...
reviews.x: I wish there was a way to choose the right shade. I thought I did a good job picking the closest shade but when I received it, it was way too dark. I couldn't use it. I purchased this product at a reduced price so I would leave a review.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the moisturizer lightweight, quickly absorbed, and effective at leaving skin smooth and glowing.
Several reviewers with sensitive skin report no irritation or redness, though a few mention irritation or clogged pores.
Some reviewers consider the product overpriced for the small amount provided, citing poor value and packaging issues.
A few reviewers say the cream is not rich enough for dry or mature skin and does not spread evenly.
Some reviewers report little to no visible results even after weeks of use.
